comparison.objective: Candidate commissions a compact shock absorber; board-TK-CQPHWE safely isolates a battery pack and removes two busbars to a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotary tuning, locking, and repeated physical testing. The battery task requires plug extraction, careful lifting of bars from studs, transport, placement, and avoidance of nearby terminals.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe, repeatable carriage stops and a retained collar setting. The battery task requires plug removal before any busbar movement, no low pass over other posts, both bars resting in the tray, and a one-second stable hold. Candidate rubric lacks numeric rebound, overload, collar-drift, and locking-torque limits; the battery record also discloses that its service plug omits the real two-stage latch.
comparison.reason: They test different objectives and mechanics: adjustment and dynamic energy absorption versus safety-ordered disconnection and conductive-part removal.
